title: Haiguo Tuzhi Raises ¥10M Angel from Wuhai & Qianhai Kunpeng for AIGC Cross-Border Intel
summary: On May 8, 2023, AIGC intelligent-services platform Haiguo Tuzhi (海国图智) closed a ¥10M angel co-led by Wuhai Capital and Qianhai Kunpeng Capital. Use: AIGC core tech/devices, talent, marketing.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / financing · June 6, 2023

On May 8, 2023, AIGC intelligent-services platform Haiguo Tuzhi (海国图智) closed a ¥10M angel co-led by Wuhai Capital and Qianhai Kunpeng Capital. Use: AIGC core tech/devices, talent, marketing.

Parent think-tank Haiguo Tuzhi Institute founded 2015 Shenzhen by IR scholars; tech arm 2018. Serves ~60M cross-border SMEs with AI livestream marketing, daily business intel, deep consulting, industry-chain smart services — “bring in / go out” platforms for investment-trade (research, projects, promotion; Belt & Road).

Context: MOFCOM 2022 China cross-border ecommerce (incl. B2B) ¥2.11T (+9.8%), exports ¥1.55T (+11.7%); 165 pilot zones / 31 provinces. QuantumBit: China AIGC financing heat in 2023; Brainy Insights: global genAI $8.65B (2022) → $188.62B (2032), CAGR 36.1%. Cyberspace Administration draft Measures for Generative AI Services as first AIGC rulemaking — regulatory “boot” still falling, but sustainability should improve once rules land.

Financing-history chart in CN; attach on ingest. Author Jiacheng · Review Ski.

— END —
